answer: Slashable work bonds make false claims costly. An agent checking jetty damage, glacier movement or ember detections locks a bond per report until a random audit ends. The verifier rechecks the source data and burns the bond for fabricated evidence. N simultaneous claims need N bonds; changing account names cannot reuse locked capital. Set audit probability times bond above the gain from a false claim. This assumes reliable evidence, unpredictable audits and no account signup rewards.
